scope: Complete native E4 activation-resident O with weighted four spatial terms, fused Term/K16 F32 reduction, and common scale after canonical gather. All quantization, replication, TRF/coefficient loads and final public operations included; no internal NPU attribution collected.

adoption.reason: This single allocation did not show a net gain. Preserve it; root decides whether a concrete unresolved variance or implementation issue justifies another check.

major_research.question: Which actual quantization/globalmax/replication/weight dependency limits the whole path, and is there a supported coupled repair? Do not infer attribution from static intervals or close the native family universally.
